topic: Decide, for each idea in Google's Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2), whether system-spec-kit should adopt, adapt or reject it, by comparing OKF with how system-spec-kit works today.

focus: Spec-kit anatomy: spec docs per level, templates, anchors, contracts, phase-parent shape
novelty: First systematic read of packet anatomy as a model: level contract manifest, anchor grammar with line addressing, lean-trio phase parent with detection rule.

focus: Spec-kit metadata: frontmatter per doc type, description.json, graph-metadata.json, _memory.continuity, validator enforcement
novelty: First map of the three metadata surfaces (authored frontmatter, generated pair, continuity block) to writers and enforcing rules, including fingerprint freshness.

focus: Spec-kit search and navigation: trigger index, ripgrep recipes, skill advisor, /speckit:search, /speckit:resume, graph traversal
novelty: Live-tested both retrieval lanes plus the separate skill-advisor graph; observed a clean no-hit on an obviously relevant domain query, bounding all index-coverage assumptions.

focus: OKF specification deep read; upstream repository verification via curl
novelty: Verified the seed spec is byte-identical to canonical upstream; read the reference implementation's executable semantics for trust tiers and staleness; examined a full practice bundle.

focus: OKF ecosystem and online resources; comparable standards llms.txt, Agent Skills, AGENTS.md
novelty: Recorded OKF's provenance (announcement, Karpathy lineage), verified a 370-repo third-party ecosystem with six independents, and positioned the three adjacent standards.

focus: Crosswalk field-by-field and file-by-file between spec-kit and OKF
novelty: Produced the first single-table crosswalk and identified the authored-vs-generated fault line plus five structural adoption conflicts.

focus: Candidate ideas and feasibility: typed concepts, per-folder index, change log, provenance, freshness, bundle export/import
novelty: Priced six candidates against measured corpus sizes with named touched surfaces; blocked import structurally; produced lean verdicts for the adversarial pass.

focus: Compatibility and blast radius per candidate across docs, validators, templates, hooks, trigger index, advisor
novelty: Named the compatibility mechanics (fail-closed corpus walker, rule registry, warn-only hooks) and produced an additive-vs-migration verdict per candidate.
Nine-point case against in-place adoption plus separability finding: every salvageable idea stands without the format; net relationship is interoperate, don't absorb.

focus: Synthesis: ranked adopt/adapt/reject recommendations with evidence, effort, risk, phase-002 shape
novelty: Terminal ranking R1-R8 with the net relationship interoperate-don't-absorb; every adopted idea is separable from the OKF format.
